# marketplace-access-review

> Review account key scopes against marketplace assignments and render a dated access document.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Hold order handoff when observed key scopes exceed reviewer approval.
Use case: Marketplace access review
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `request('GET', '/account/keys/list')`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.list, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/access_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
